features.name: Project Selection (Hub)
features.description: User selects which project to work on from hub page
features.user_journey: Hub → Click project card → Navigate to workspace

features.name: Create New Project
features.description: User creates a new project with workspace bindings
features.user_journey: Hub → Click 'New Project' → Fill details → Create

features.name: Delete Project
features.description: User deletes a project with confirmation
features.user_journey: Hub → Click project menu → Delete → Confirm

features.name: Edit Project Metadata
features.description: User edits project name, description, and workspace bindings
features.user_journey: Hub → Click project → Edit metadata → Save

features.name: Workspace Switching
features.description: Switch between workspaces (Notes, IDE, Knowledge, Study) with state persistence
features.user_journey: Workspace → Click workspace icon → Navigate to route → State restores

features.name: Workspace Binding Configuration
features.description: Configure which workspaces are enabled for a project
features.user_journey: Hub → Click project → Edit bindings → Select workspaces → Save

features.name: Platform Detection
features.user_journey: Application loads → Detect platform → Adjust features

features.name: Storage Adapter Selection
features.description: Auto-select optimal storage type (FSA for desktop, IndexedDB for mobile)
features.user_journey: Project loads → Detect platform → Create adapter → Use storage

features.name: Route Guards (Platform Validation)
features.description: Block access to IDE on mobile devices
features.user_journey: Mobile user → Try to access IDE → Blocked → Redirect to Notes

features.name: Project Context (Cross-Workspace State)
features.description: Shared project context passed to all workspaces
features.user_journey: Project loads → Context set → Workspaces access via useProjectContext

features.name: Workspace-Scoped State
features.description: Isolate workspace state per project to prevent cross-project contamination
features.user_journey: Project switches → Workspace store created for project → State isolated

features.name: Cross-Workspace Event Bus
features.description: Event-driven communication between workspaces (FILE_SAVED, FILE_DELETED, etc.)
features.user_journey: Event fires → Workspaces subscribed → React to changes

features.name: Cross-Workspace File References
features.description: Manage file references between workspaces (e.g., IDE file referenced in Notes)
features.user_journey: Workspace A references Workspace B file → Reference created → Tracked

features.name: File System Access API Routing
features.description: Route file operations through FSA (desktop) or IndexedDB (mobile)
features.user_journey: File operation requested → Platform detected → Adapter selected → Operation executed

features.name: Unified Chat Panel (Cross-Workspace)
features.description: Single chat interface shared across all workspaces with workspace-scoped context
features.user_journey: Notes/IDE → Open chat → Same chat, different context

features.name: Agent Selector (Cross-Workspace)
features.description: Unified agent selector that syncs across workspaces
features.user_journey: Notes/IDE → Select AI provider → Selection synced across workspaces

features.name: Project Selector (Dropdown)
features.description: Dropdown to quickly switch between projects without returning to hub
features.user_journey: Workspace → Click project selector → Select project → Navigate

features.name: Sync Service Factory
features.description: Create appropriate sync service based on workspace type and storage
features.user_journey: Workspace loads → Factory creates sync service → Sync initialized

features.name: File Watcher Factory
features.description: Create file watcher based on storage type (FSAObserver for FSA, Polling for IndexedDB)
features.user_journey: Workspace loads → Factory creates watcher → Files monitored

feature_flags.description: Block IDE access on mobile devices (platform validation)
feature_flags.implementation: Platform detection in route-guards.ts: requireIDEAccess() throws redirect if mobile

feature_flags.description: Enable File System Access API storage for desktop devices
feature_flags.implementation: Platform detection: getOptimalStorageType() returns 'fsa' for desktop with FSA support

feature_flags.description: Enable WebContainer preview for IDE workspace
feature_flags.implementation: WebContainer boot in PreviewPanel - supports live preview if SharedArrayBuffer and COOP/COEP headers present

feature_flags.description: Enable auto-save with configurable debounce times
feature_flags.implementation: Debounced save hooks - Notes uses 500ms debounce, IDE uses 2000ms debounce

feature_flags.description: Enable workspace-scoped state to prevent cross-project contamination
feature_flags.implementation: createWorkspaceStore(workspaceType, projectId) creates isolated store per project

overlaps.conflict_description: Both workspaces use StorageAdapterFactory for optimal storage selection. Unified logic exists but different usage patterns - IDE uses direct adapters, Notes uses via NotesFileSyncService wrapper.
Both routes wrap components in ProjectProvider. Good unification, but context loading differs slightly (loader vs provider prop).
Same component used in both workspaces. Good unification, but conversation state should be workspace-scoped for proper isolation.
Same component used in both workspaces. Agent selection state should be unified to cross-workspace.
Three different debounce times and implementations. Notes uses 500ms, IDE uses 2000ms, sync services have their own logic. Should use unified auto-save hook.
Same component and store used across workspaces. Good unification, but sync services differ (NotesFileSyncService vs IDESyncService).
Both workspaces perform file operations but through different paths. IDE uses direct storage adapters, Notes uses via sync services. Consolidation opportunity.
Same component and hooks used across workspaces. Good unification. State isolation via workspace-scoped stores is properly implemented.
All workspaces subscribe to same event bus for cross-workspace reactivity. Good unification.
